message.content:
Below is a quick‑start “starter‑kit” for a **Startup Statistics API** that you can either:

1. **Use as a reference** when you’re building your own service, or  
2. **Call directly** if you want a ready‑to‑use endpoint (the example uses the free **Crunchbase Public API** – you’ll need a key).

---

## 1.  Sample API Design (REST)

| Endpoint | Method | Description | Query Params | Response |
|----------|--------|-------------|--------------|----------|
| `/api/startups` | `GET` | List startups with optional filters | `search`, `industry`, `location`, `min_funding`, `max_funding`, `page`, `per_page` | JSON array of startup objects |
| `/api/startups/{id}` | `GET` | Get a single startup’s full profile | – | JSON object |
| `/api/startups/{id}/funding` | `GET` | Get all funding rounds for a startup | – | JSON array of funding round objects |
| `/api/startups/{id}/employees` | `GET` | Get employee count & distribution | – | JSON object |

### Example Startup Object

```json
{
  "id": "12345",
  "name": "Acme AI",
  "website": "https://acme.ai",
  "logo_url": "https://cdn.acme.ai/logo.png",
  "industry": "Artificial Intelligence",
  "location": {
    "city": "San Francisco",
    "state": "CA",
    "country": "USA"
  },
  "founded_at": "2018-04-12",
  "employees": 42,
  "valuation": 120000000,
  "funding_total": 75000000,
  "funding_rounds": [
    {
      "type": "Series A",
      "amount": 30000000,
      "date": "2020-07-01",
      "investors": ["VC Firm X", "VC Firm Y"]
    },
    {
      "type": "Series B",
      "amount": 45000000,
      "date": "2022-03-15",
      "investors": ["VC Firm Z"]
    }
  ],
  "description": "Acme AI builds AI‑driven analytics for e‑commerce."
}
```

---

## 2.  Quick‑Start Using Crunchbase Public API

Crunchbase offers a free tier that returns most of the fields above.  
(You’ll need to sign up for an API key at <https://data.crunchbase.com>.)

### 2.1  Endpoint

```
GET https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations
```

### 2.2  Required Header

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_CRUNCHBASE_API_KEY
```

### 2.3  Query Parameters

| Param | Type | Example | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `user_key` | string | `YOUR_CRUNCHBASE_API_KEY` | API key (also works as header) |
| `query` | string | `Acme AI` | Search term |
| `page` | int | `1` | Pagination |
| `page_size` | int | `20` | Items per page |
| `location` | string | `San Francisco` | Filter by city |
| `category_code` | string | `artificial-intelligence` | Filter by industry |

### 2.4  Sample Request (cURL)

```bash
curl -G \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_CRUNCHBASE_API_KEY" \
  -d "query=Acme AI" \
  -d "page=1" \
  -d "page_size=10" \
  "https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations"
```

### 2.5  Sample Response (truncated)

```json
{
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "name": "Acme AI",
        "permalink": "acme-ai",
        "homepage_url": "https://acme.ai",
        "logo_url": "https://logo.clearbit.com/acme.ai",
        "location": {
          "city": "San Francisco",
          "state": "CA",
          "country": "USA"
        },
        "founded_on": "2018-04-12",
        "number_of_employees": 42,
        "total_funding_usd": 75000000,
        "valuation_usd": 120000000,
        "category_codes": ["artificial-intelligence"],
        "description": "Acme AI builds AI‑driven analytics for e‑commerce."
      }
    ],
    "paging": {
      "next_page_url": "https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations?page=2&page_size=10"
    }
  }
}
```

> **Tip:** The Crunchbase response contains many more fields (e.g., `funding_rounds`, `investors`, `acquisitions`). You can map those to the fields in the sample object above.

---

## 3.  Building Your Own API (Node.js + Express)

If you prefer a custom wrapper around Crunchbase (or any other source), here’s a minimal example:

```js
// server.js
const express = require('express');
const axios = require('axios');
const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Replace with your Crunchbase API key
const CRUNCHBASE_KEY = process.env.CRUNCHBASE_KEY;

app.get('/api/startups', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { query, page = 1, page_size = 10 } = req.query;
    const response = await axios.get('https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations', {
      params: { query, page, page_size, user_key: CRUNCHBASE_KEY },
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${CRUNCHBASE_KEY}` }
    });

    // Map Crunchbase items to our simplified schema
    const startups = response.data.data.items.map(item => ({
      id: item.permalink,
      name: item.name,
      website: item.homepage_url,
      logo_url: item.logo_url,
      industry: item.category_codes?.[0] ?? null,
      location: item.location,
      founded_at: item.founded_on,
      employees: item.number_of_employees,
      valuation: item.valuation_usd,
      funding_total: item.total_funding_usd,
      description: item.description
    }));

    res.json({ startups, nextPage: response.data.data.paging?.next_page_url });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch startup data' });
  }
});

app.listen(PORT, () => console.log(`🚀 Server listening on port ${PORT}`));
```

> **Deploy** this on any platform (Heroku, Vercel, Fly.io) and expose `/api/startups`.  
> **Add caching** (Redis, in‑memory) to reduce Crunchbase quota usage.

---

## 4.  Other Public Sources

| Source | API | Notes |
|--------|-----|-------|
| AngelList | `https://api.angel.co/1/companies` | Requires OAuth token; free tier limited. |
| PitchBook | Private API | Commercial; requires subscription. |
| CB Insights | Private API | Commercial; requires subscription. |
| Crunchbase | `https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations` | Free tier available; generous limits. |
| Startup API (unofficial) | `https://api.startupapi.com/v1/startups` | Community‑maintained; check docs. |

---

## 5.  Quick Python Client (using `requests`)

```python
import requests

CRUNCHBASE_KEY = "YOUR_CRUNCHBASE_API_KEY"

def search_startups(query, page=1, page_size=10):
    url = "https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations"
    params = {
        "query": query,
        "page": page,
        "page_size": page_size,
        "user_key": CRUNCHBASE_KEY
    }
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {CRUNCHBASE_KEY}"}
    r = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    data = search_startups("Acme AI")
    print(data["data"]["items"][0]["name"])
```

---

### TL;DR

- **Use Crunchbase** (free tier) for most startup stats.  
- **Wrap** it in your own API if you need custom filtering, caching, or a different schema.  
- **Alternatively**, explore AngelList or other commercial APIs if you need deeper data.
